sync.confirm_upload:
Upload this collection to AnkiWeb?

The collection on AnkiWeb will be replaced. Changes made on other devices since their last sync will be lost.
sync.confirm_download:
Download the collection from AnkiWeb?

The collection on this Switch will be replaced. Changes made here since the last sync will be lost.
sync.conflict:
This collection and AnkiWeb's have both changed in ways that can't be merged.

Choose which one to keep.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restore_confirm:
Replace your collection with the backup from {}?

Your current collection is backed up first. The next sync will ask whether to upload or download.
settings.restored: Backup restored. The next sync will ask whether to upload or download.
settings.backups_note: A backup is made when you close the app, at most every 30 minutes, if the collection changed. The 10 newest are kept in {}. Backups don't include media files.
settings.swipe_answers: Swipe to answer (← Again, ↓ Hard, → Good, ↑ Easy)
settings.tap_zones_four: Again · Hard · Good · Easy, left to right
settings.auto_sync: Automatic sync (open, after studying, exit with +)
settings.sync_server_prompt: Self-hosted sync server URL (empty for AnkiWeb)
settings.sync_server_changed: Sync server changed: log in again
settings.language_restart: Restart AnkiNX to change the language
settings.nature_peaceful_note: Miss a day: nothing is lost. A week or more away leaves a pond in the forest.
settings.nature_wild_note: Miss two days in a row: smoke rises as a warning. Miss a third: a fire spreads until seven days of study put it out. Bad habits leave marks too.
settings.nature_merciless_note: Miss a day of reviews: an asteroid waits in the sky, and strikes when Anki's day ends unless you review. A new forest grows from its crater. Bad habits leave marks too.
settings.nature_switch_back: Switch back any time and every tree is there again.
settings.weather_prompt: Your city, for the forest's weather
settings.weather_note: The forest shows your city's weather, and the time of day by your clock. To find the city, its name is sent to Photon (OpenStreetMap), and its position to MET Norway for the forecast. Weather data from MET Norway, CC BY 4.0.
settings.forest_note: A forest that grows from your study, behind the deck list: a tree for each day you learn new cards, growing as you remember them. To walk through it, tap the tree count by your streak or press L. From the Memory Forest add-on by Barak Levy.

controls.change_grip: Change grip / order (use one Joy-Con sideways)
